Sample Person Ten
Registered Nurse | Pediatric Acute Care | Patient and Family Education | Charge Nurse at Example Children's Hospital
Orange, California

About
Pediatric registered nurse with seven years at the bedside in acute care. I look after children recovering from surgery and serious illness, and I spend as much time teaching families as I do giving medications.

As a charge nurse I coordinate a 24-bed unit, mentor new graduates, and lead our unit's fall-prevention work, which has kept us at zero falls with injury for 18 months. I precept four to six new nurses a year and I helped rewrite our discharge teaching so families go home with a plan they understand.

I am certified in pediatric nursing and I teach PALS classes twice a year.

Message me if you want to talk about pediatric nursing or precepting.
